categories.evidence: Matches 'Tests' label and modifies unit test infrastructure in src/test/util/common.{h,cpp} along with assertion macros across unit test files.
categories.rationale: Improves unit test failure diagnostics by defining stream output operators and switching boolean checks to value-printing equality macros. As noted in the description, 'If the `<<` operator exists, boost can use this as a debug output when a check fails' and prepares types for the framework migration in #35713.
